scripts.dev: test -x backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn || { echo 'Run `npm run setup` first.'; exit 1; }; trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; (cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --no-access-log --reload --reload-dir app) & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.test: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npx playwright test
scripts.audit: cd backend && .venv/bin/pip-audit -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm audit --omit=dev
